title: Record native training and learning probes of the yaw-gated stride reward
summary: Source 1b4d67a1 trained reward v4 with the yaw-gated task natively at seed 20260917: turn-heavy sampling (30 percent of moving draws become turns), the yaw gate on turns with a 0.25 bonus and a 0.5 floor, stride tracking 0.3, stride length 2 and termination 22, 128 robots. At 48,000 controls per robot, 24, 36 and 48 controls per update for 2000, 1333 and 1000 updates passed 0, 0 and 2 of 13 learning probes and walked at about 0.4 to 0.5 of the command. At 120,000 controls per robot, 48 controls per update for 2500 updates passed all 13: turns at +0.199 and -0.226 rad/s against 0.2, all eight 0.05 m/s walks and both quiet probes and the stop, with heading drift of 16.0 degrees on average and 32.6 at most over the walks. One seed; learning probes are diagnostics and Stage 2 remains incomplete. The first c24 launch failed before training because the container user could not read the pack.
next: Repeat the 48-control, 2500-update launch at seed 20260918 and review the native videos and force and torque records with the program lead.
reason: One seed of learning-probe diagnostics; the record changes no capability state and admits no Stage 2 result.
